_status: Checked against `brev ... --help` from brev CLI v0.6.335 on 2026-10-25: login, create, delete, ls, refresh. Still unconfirmed until the first real run: that `ssh <name>` works after `brev refresh`, and the CLI installer URL used by the workflow.

login.note: VERIFIED 2026-10-25 against `brev login --help` (flag: --token string, 'token provided to auto login'). Token source in the console still to be confirmed.

create_check.note: Lists the types create will accept under its default filters (e.g. min 500GB disk), as 'type (NNNGB disk), ...'. The controller refuses unless the chosen type is listed. With --type, --dry-run only echoes the type back, so it is not a check.

price.note: VERIFIED 2026-10-26 (Actions run 40408720343): table with TYPE first and $/HR last, e.g. 'massedcompute_L40S ... $1.06'. Read-only.

create.note: VERIFIED: -t/--type takes instance types (comma list = fallback chain, which the guard forbids); -g is --gpu-name, a search filter, not a type. Waits for readiness unless --detached; --timeout is seconds per instance (default 300).

refresh.note: VERIFIED: 'Force a refresh to the SSH config'

list.note: VERIFIED: when stdout is piped, prints instance names only, one per line

exec.note: SSH alias written by `brev refresh`; confirm `ssh <name>` on the first run

delete.note: VERIFIED: `brev delete <name>`; deletion can take a few minutes, check with `brev ls`. Delete, not stop: stopped instances still bill for storage.
